title: Welcome screen shown when signed out
steps: 1. Open the app with no prior session
expected_result: Welcome screen shown: logo, title "Qicau: Say it, Save it.", 3 feature bullets, "Lanjutkan dengan Google" button; no tab navigation visible

title: Loading skeleton shown while auth state resolves
steps: 1. Observe the app in the moment before login state resolves
expected_result: Skeleton/placeholder shown, not the login page nor the main app

title: Successful Google sign-in lands on Catat tab
expected_result: Lands on Catat tab; header and bottom nav (Catat/Riwayat/Bulanan) shown

title: Closing the login popup leaves user on login page without error
steps:
1. Open the Google sign-in popup
2. Close it without completing sign-in
expected_result: No error/alert shown; user remains on the login page

title: Login failure (other than user-cancelled) shows an alert
preconditions: Signed out; sign-in configured to fail with a non-cancel error
steps:
1. Attempt Google sign-in
2. Force an error other than popup-closed

title: Sign out via Settings ends the session
expected_result: Session ends, returns to login page, settings modal closes

title: User A never sees or modifies User B's data
preconditions: Two signed-in users A and B, each with own transactions
steps:
1. As A, attempt to read/list B's transactions/history
2. As A, attempt to modify/delete a transaction belonging to B
expected_result: A cannot see or change B's data at any point (UI or underlying request)

title: Root path after login opens Catat tab
tab query param opens the matching tab
steps:
1. Navigate to "/?tab=history"
2. Navigate to "/?tab=monthly"
3. Navigate to "/?tab=home"
expected_result: The corresponding tab (Riwayat / Bulanan / Catat) is active in each case

title: Unknown tab query value falls back to Catat without error
expected_result: Catat tab active, no error shown

title: Clicking a tab switches content and highlights it
steps:
1. Click Riwayat tab
2. Click Bulanan tab
3. Click Catat tab
expected_result: Content changes accordingly each time; active tab is visually marked

title: Settings modal shows theme install sign-out and close
expected_result: "Pengaturan" modal shows Theme options (Sistem/Terang/Gelap), an install-app button, "Keluar", "Tutup"

title: Selecting Dark/Light theme applies immediately and persists
steps:
1. Select "Gelap"
2. Reload the app
3. Select "Terang"
4. Reload the app
expected_result: Theme changes immediately each time and is still applied after reload

title: System theme follows OS preference and updates live
preconditions: Settings modal open, theme set to "Sistem"
steps:
1. Select "Sistem"
2. Change the OS-level dark/light preference
expected_result: App theme follows the OS preference and updates when the OS setting changes

title: Wide desktop screen keeps content in a centered column
steps: 1. Open the app on a wide desktop browser window
expected_result: Content is constrained to a centered column, not full width
